**The two classes are never pooled into one number.** Twenty near-certain
calendar calls score around 0.05 between them; six genuine thesis calls score
around 0.22. A pooled 0.09 would describe neither and would flatter the harder
work with the easier.

The one statistic that pools fairly is the calibration curve below — whether a
stated 70% means 70% is a fair question at any level of difficulty.
